title: Tim Cook says Apple expects "the impact from the supply constraints to increase significantly sequentially" and the market pricing for memory to keep rising (Juli Clover/MacRumors)
summary: Juli Clover / MacRumors: Tim Cook says Apple expects “the impact from the supply constraints to increase significantly sequentially” and the market pricing for memory to keep rising — Apple is expecting supply constraints to have a much bigger impact on revenue during the September quarter …
